Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649965. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, filter by assay_chembl_id CHEMBL4649965, standard_value not null, standard_relation equals. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
